criteria_evaluation.object_specified_not_inferred: Satisfied. The AdoptedDraftingStandard shape follows PM035's owning-object scope with the authored-adoption vs resolved-presentation split, the one-per-Project and no-silent-default invariants, and the shared ObjectId/ObjectRevision/deterministic-shard identity discipline — explicitly not inferred from existing settings rows.
criteria_evaluation.standards_basis_honest: Satisfied. Registry references carry the six-disposition provenance model; unavailable/incompatible/unlicensed bases resolve to typed states with no silent substitution and no false conformance; a registry reference is neither normative text nor certification.
criteria_evaluation.typed_authority_single_path: Satisfied. One engine-owned typed mutation/query path shared by GUI/CLI/scripting/MCP, with expected-revision guards, atomicity, typed refusal, journal, compensating undo and proposal/acceptance — a future operation contract, with inspection unable to write and no private writer for any consumer.
criteria_evaluation.existing_authorities_preserved: Satisfied. Canonical nm geometry, PM040 working units, PM023 snap, PM034 revision/status/release and Publish template/annotation ownership are consumed, never redefined; a convention change is presentation-only and can never mutate issued bytes or allocate an engineering revision.
criteria_evaluation.selections_routed_migration_designed: Satisfied. S1-S4 (standard/edition/convention selections, unavailable-behavior policy, new mechanism/schema/migration model, final schema name) route to the owner at ADS-C04 with evidence-backed options; migration is designed with discovery/authorization/atomicity/rollback and the never-manufacture-a-historical-receipt rule, with design and execution as separate authorization boundaries; native proof is specified, not performed.
